exchanges.author: worker
exchanges.body: Luis, three fixes before tomorrow: (1) FY2027 is at most half a year: a supplemental can't fund positions before it's enacted, so with a realistic April start, 4 FTE x $90,000 x 1.32 x 3 months = $118,800; even from January 1 it's 6 months, $237,600, not $475,200. (2) Remove the $164,800 contingency: OFM requires costs we can support, and padding hurts credibility. (3) The ongoing level is right: $475,200 a year from FY2028 (use 33.5% benefits for 2027-29 to match OFM: $480,600). Please add the dropout data behind the 31% and what change you expect.

Request: 4.0 FTE apprenticeship navigators to reduce first-year apprentice dropout (currently 31%).
Start: January 1, 2027 (the supplemental takes effect when signed, expected late March; hiring from April is
more realistic). Salary $90,000 each; benefits 32%.

versions.author: worker
versions.content:
# HB 1214 fiscal note: DWT (final for OFM)

Summary: HB 1214 requires DWT to build and run an apprentice tracking system and report annually from 12/1/2028. Effective 7/1/2027.

Expenditures, General Fund-State (001-1):
| | FY2028 | FY2029 | 2027-29 | 2029-31 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| FTE | 2.5 | 2.0 | 2.25 | 2.0 |
| Salaries | 240,000 | 192,000 | 432,000 | 384,000 |
| Benefits (33.5%, OFM standard) | 80,400 | 64,320 | 144,720 | 128,640 |
| Goods and services ($8,000/FTE) | 16,000 | 16,000 | 32,000 | 32,000 |
| Implementation (one time) | 480,000 | 0 | 480,000 | 0 |
| Subscription | 0 | 72,000 | 72,000 | 144,000 |
| ESD wage match | 18,000 | 18,000 | 36,000 | 36,000 |
| Total | 834,400 | 362,320 | 1,196,720 | 724,640 |

Assumptions: vendor-hosted system (program estimate); 2.0 FTE IT Business Analysts ongoing and a 0.5 FTE project manager in FY2028 only; ESD data-sharing $18,000 a year. No revenue. No costs in 2025-27.
